_about: Pack CS proof (2026-11-03): three cards in the proposed one-source format (book/card-source-proposal.md). Throwaway: nothing reads this but proof.mjs and book_block.py.

cards.name: Weapon Attack
cards.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.
cards.rules: You attack with the weapon you are wielding. Weapon Attack takes the Melee or Ranged trait of that weapon, and its Range.

cards.name: Smite
cards.flavor: Your weapon blazes with holy light.

versions.effects: The target sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation and takes 1 Bane when they try to hide, for 1 round.

foundry.effects: The target sheds Bright light in a [1Emanation 1/round] and takes 1 Bane when they try to hide, for 1 round.

versions.effects: As 1 AP, but a 2 Emanation. You or one ally in the light gain +1 Defense for 1 round.

foundry.effects: The target sheds Bright light in a [2Emanation 1/round] and takes 1 Bane when they try to hide, for 1 round. You or one ally in the light gain @Effect[{{fx:Smite (+1 Defense)}}]{+1 Defense for 1 round}.

versions.effects: As 2 AP, and you or one ally in the light gain [[Guard]] 1d8 + [Mod]. You choose who gains the Defense and who gains the Guard separately: the same creature or two different ones.

foundry.effects: The target sheds Bright light in a [2Emanation 1/round] and takes 1 Bane when they try to hide, for 1 round. You or one ally in the light gain @Effect[{{fx:Smite (+1 Defense)}}]{+1 Defense for 1 round}. You or one ally in the light gain @Guard[1d8+mod]{Guard 1d8 + [Mod]}. You choose who gains the Defense and who gains the Guard separately: the same creature or two different ones.

versions.ruler: on 2+: defense 1 ally; on 2+: guard 1d8+[Mod] self

cards.name: Lock & Loose
cards.flavor: A bolt to the knee, and they go nowhere.

tiers: [B] 1d4+2+[Mod] Pi; For 1 round, the creature is Hindered until they use a Move Action.

foundry.x2: For 1 round, the creature is Hindered until they use a Move Action.

versions.ruler: on 2: debuff Hindered (until it moves); on 3: debuff Immobilized
